items.title: [Steam新闻] An Apology and Further Adjustments to the D-Effect Zone
items.summary: In V2.6.0, we made substantial changes to the D-Effect Zone to bring you greater challenges and rewards to match.However, those changes were clearly not well received. The steep difficulty curve, in particular, led to a frustrating experience for Keepers at different stages of progression: too easy for some, too difficult for others. This was certainly not what we intended.On reflection, I believe that, given the current state of the game, insisting on fitting the difficulty into just four tiers...
